meta.title: Lost Inflection
meta.description: Amidst your aimless wandering, a ray of light appears and shines on a different path.

units.rawText: I can say the same... it is fantastic to see you again.
units.displayText: I can say the same... it is fantastic to see you again.

spans.text: I can say the same... it is fantastic to see you again.

units.rawText: Let's go. We'll go meet our new friends, along with Knot and Lind.
units.displayText: Let's go. We'll go meet our new friends, along with Knot and Lind.

spans.text: Let's go. We'll go meet our new friends, along with Knot and Lind.

units.rawText: The Professor has a private Sector called the <color=orange>"Oasis"</color>. We'll go there.
units.displayText: The Professor has a private Sector called the "Oasis". We'll go there.

spans.text: The Professor has a private Sector called the
"Oasis"
. We'll go there.

units.rawText: It will be our home.
units.displayText: It will be our home.

spans.text: It will be our home.

units.rawText: Pzzt...
units.displayText: Pzzt...

spans.text: Pzzt...

units.rawText: I never would have thought that... being at everyone's side in the cloud through thick and thin would make me so happy.
units.displayText: I never would have thought that... being at everyone's side in the cloud through thick and thin would make me so happy.

spans.text: I never would have thought that... being at everyone's side in the cloud through thick and thin would make me so happy.

units.rawText: I can't stop moving forward, either.
units.displayText: I can't stop moving forward, either.

spans.text: I can't stop moving forward, either.

units.rawText: You—can't you say something?
units.displayText: You—can't you say something?

spans.text: You—can't you say something?

units.rawText: Pzzzzzt—
units.displayText: Pzzzzzt—

spans.text: Pzzzzzt—

units.rawText: Professor! Make sure you keep watching me from now on!
units.displayText: Professor! Make sure you keep watching me from now on!

spans.text: Professor! Make sure you keep watching me from now on!

units.rawText: Or else it'll suck if you get lost!
units.displayText: Or else it'll suck if you get lost!

spans.text: Or else it'll suck if you get lost!

units.rawText: Who am I... Where am I... And where am I going?
units.displayText: Who am I... Where am I... And where am I going?

spans.text: Who am I... Where am I... And where am I going?

units.rawText: The violet abyss in the distance beckons me. I know that is where I should be going.
units.displayText: The violet abyss in the distance beckons me. I know that is where I should be going.

spans.text: The violet abyss in the distance beckons me. I know that is where I should be going.

units.rawText: But every time I try to head toward it, I am pulled back, as though bound by a chain. Something is tugging on me—
units.displayText: But every time I try to head toward it, I am pulled back, as though bound by a chain. Something is tugging on me—

spans.text: But every time I try to head toward it, I am pulled back, as though bound by a chain. Something is tugging on me—

units.rawText: When I look back, it isn't just hands holding onto the chain. Rather, there are countless physical entities there, but the dream obscures their faces, and I can't identify them.
units.displayText: When I look back, it isn't just hands holding onto the chain. Rather, there are countless physical entities there, but the dream obscures their faces, and I can't identify them.

spans.text: When I look back, it isn't just hands holding onto the chain. Rather, there are countless physical entities there, but the dream obscures their faces, and I can't identify them.

units.rawText: More and more people appear behind them. I am trapped by a layered labyrinth, and all of them are saying a single name—
units.displayText: More and more people appear behind them. I am trapped by a layered labyrinth, and all of them are saying a single name—

spans.text: More and more people appear behind them. I am trapped by a layered labyrinth, and all of them are saying a single name—

units.rawText: <color=orange>"Sol."</color>
units.displayText: "Sol."

spans.text: "Sol."

units.rawText: You were dreaming again.
units.displayText: You were dreaming again.

spans.text: You were dreaming again.

units.rawText: It must be hard to escape the interference of the redundant data. Free yourself from your dreams, my child.
units.displayText: It must be hard to escape the interference of the redundant data. Free yourself from your dreams, my child.

spans.text: It must be hard to escape the interference of the redundant data. Free yourself from your dreams, my child.

units.rawText: Lady Malkira...
units.displayText: Lady Malkira...

spans.text: Lady Malkira...

units.rawText: There were many people in my dream, and I don't remember them. But they knew my name. They called me Sol.
units.displayText: There were many people in my dream, and I don't remember them. But they knew my name. They called me Sol.

spans.text: There were many people in my dream, and I don't remember them. But they knew my name. They called me Sol.

units.rawText: Do I really not know them? They seemed very close to me in my dream.
units.displayText: Do I really not know them? They seemed very close to me in my dream.

spans.text: Do I really not know them? They seemed very close to me in my dream.

units.rawText: You are an Entropic. They do not exist in the world of Entropics. Therefore, they are nothing more than illusions to you.
units.displayText: You are an Entropic. They do not exist in the world of Entropics. Therefore, they are nothing more than illusions to you.

spans.text: You are an Entropic. They do not exist in the world of Entropics. Therefore, they are nothing more than illusions to you.

units.rawText: But what about outside this world, this world of Entropics?
units.displayText: But what about outside this world, this world of Entropics?

spans.text: But what about outside this world, this world of Entropics?

units.rawText: Perhaps they are gathered together in some corner of the cloud. However, they will only ever be your enemies, without the closeness and camaraderie you described.
units.displayText: Perhaps they are gathered together in some corner of the cloud. However, they will only ever be your enemies, without the closeness and camaraderie you described.

spans.text: Perhaps they are gathered together in some corner of the cloud. However, they will only ever be your enemies, without the closeness and camaraderie you described.

units.rawText: Is it because I am an Entropic?
units.displayText: Is it because I am an Entropic?

spans.text: Is it because I am an Entropic?

units.rawText: Yes, it is because you are an Entropic. From the moment you were born, your very existence is diametrically opposed to theirs.
units.displayText: Yes, it is because you are an Entropic. From the moment you were born, your very existence is diametrically opposed to theirs.

spans.text: Yes, it is because you are an Entropic. From the moment you were born, your very existence is diametrically opposed to theirs.

units.rawText: You must tear them apart, infect their neural clouds and devour all order and reason.
units.displayText: You must tear them apart, infect their neural clouds and devour all order and reason.

spans.text: You must tear them apart, infect their neural clouds and devour all order and reason.

units.rawText: Hehe... My dear child, abandon your hesitation and do not allow this redundant data to mar your elegance. The grand performance is about to begin... so let us bask in this pleasure that our existence beholds.
units.displayText: Hehe... My dear child, abandon your hesitation and do not allow this redundant data to mar your elegance. The grand performance is about to begin... so let us bask in this pleasure that our existence beholds.

spans.text: Hehe... My dear child, abandon your hesitation and do not allow this redundant data to mar your elegance. The grand performance is about to begin... so let us bask in this pleasure that our existence beholds.

units.rawText: The pink-haired girl collapses to the ground, wounded, but her eyes glow with a seemingly magical light.
units.displayText: The pink-haired girl collapses to the ground, wounded, but her eyes glow with a seemingly magical light.

spans.text: The pink-haired girl collapses to the ground, wounded, but her eyes glow with a seemingly magical light.

units.rawText: ...At last, you're looking at me, Sol.
units.displayText: ...At last, you're looking at me, Sol.

spans.text: ...At last, you're looking at me, Sol.

units.rawText: Though she tried her best to avoid looking Persicaria in the eye, she ended up glimpsing her face in the end, and the scenes from her memories all resolved into clarity.
units.displayText: Though she tried her best to avoid looking Persicaria in the eye, she ended up glimpsing her face in the end, and the scenes from her memories all resolved into clarity.

spans.text: Though she tried her best to avoid looking Persicaria in the eye, she ended up glimpsing her face in the end, and the scenes from her memories all resolved into clarity.

units.rawText: No... You're nothing more than redundant data.
units.displayText: No... You're nothing more than redundant data.

spans.text: No... You're nothing more than redundant data.

units.rawText: Sol mutters to herself, struggling to repress the memories and feelings that are coming to mind unbidden.
units.displayText: Sol mutters to herself, struggling to repress the memories and feelings that are coming to mind unbidden.

spans.text: Sol mutters to herself, struggling to repress the memories and feelings that are coming to mind unbidden.

units.rawText: How could mere redundant data get in my way?!
units.displayText: How could mere redundant data get in my way?!

spans.text: How could mere redundant data get in my way?!

units.rawText: Sol seizes the initiative and rushes in, wreathed in bloodlust. Persicaria watches closely with bated breath, carefully observing her opponent's movements. Then, as though she's already predicted Sol's movements, she steps to the side and nimbly evades her attack.
units.displayText: Sol seizes the initiative and rushes in, wreathed in bloodlust. Persicaria watches closely with bated breath, carefully observing her opponent's movements. Then, as though she's already predicted Sol's movements, she steps to the side and nimbly evades her attack.

spans.text: Sol seizes the initiative and rushes in, wreathed in bloodlust. Persicaria watches closely with bated breath, carefully observing her opponent's movements. Then, as though she's already predicted Sol's movements, she steps to the side and nimbly evades her attack.

units.rawText: Sol whirls her weapon around and hacks at Persicaria's right shoulder, but her opponent easily deflects the attack again.
units.displayText: Sol whirls her weapon around and hacks at Persicaria's right shoulder, but her opponent easily deflects the attack again.

spans.text: Sol whirls her weapon around and hacks at Persicaria's right shoulder, but her opponent easily deflects the attack again.

units.rawText: Why...
units.displayText: Why...

spans.text: Why...

units.rawText: We've been comrades for a long time. Nobody knows your tells better than me.
units.displayText: We've been comrades for a long time. Nobody knows your tells better than me.

spans.text: We've been comrades for a long time. Nobody knows your tells better than me.

units.rawText: If you're this shaken, that must mean you've remembered something, right?
units.displayText: If you're this shaken, that must mean you've remembered something, right?

spans.text: If you're this shaken, that must mean you've remembered something, right?

units.rawText: Sol is unable to respond. Persicaria uses this opportunity to close the distance and forcefully thrusts up.
units.displayText: Sol is unable to respond. Persicaria uses this opportunity to close the distance and forcefully thrusts up.

spans.text: Sol is unable to respond. Persicaria uses this opportunity to close the distance and forcefully thrusts up.

units.rawText: The blonde girl frantically brings her weapon around to block the strike and sparks fly as steel meets steel. The pink-haired girl swings again, in a complete replication of her opponent's attack!
units.displayText: The blonde girl frantically brings her weapon around to block the strike and sparks fly as steel meets steel. The pink-haired girl swings again, in a complete replication of her opponent's attack!

spans.text: The blonde girl frantically brings her weapon around to block the strike and sparks fly as steel meets steel. The pink-haired girl swings again, in a complete replication of her opponent's attack!

units.rawText: You taught me this move! Now, I'll pay it back!
units.displayText: You taught me this move! Now, I'll pay it back!

spans.text: You taught me this move! Now, I'll pay it back!

units.rawText: <size=40>Swiftflame Slash!!</size>
units.displayText: Swiftflame Slash!!

spans.text: Swiftflame Slash!!

units.rawText: Clang!
units.displayText: Clang!

spans.text: Clang!

units.rawText: Urgh...
units.displayText: Urgh...

spans.text: Urgh...

units.rawText: Sol stumbles several steps back, and her sword wielding hand begins to tremble.
units.displayText: Sol stumbles several steps back, and her sword wielding hand begins to tremble.

spans.text: Sol stumbles several steps back, and her sword wielding hand begins to tremble.

units.rawText: Persicaria uses this opportunity to slip her blade past her opponent's defenses, scoring a shallow cut on Sol's chest and rattling the chains there.
units.displayText: Persicaria uses this opportunity to slip her blade past her opponent's defenses, scoring a shallow cut on Sol's chest and rattling the chains there.

spans.text: Persicaria uses this opportunity to slip her blade past her opponent's defenses, scoring a shallow cut on Sol's chest and rattling the chains there.

units.rawText: Was it all... a lie?
units.displayText: Was it all... a lie?

spans.text: Was it all... a lie?

units.rawText: Someone is knocking on the purple-hued glass walls of the room. There is someone behind the glass, calling to her.
units.displayText: Someone is knocking on the purple-hued glass walls of the room. There is someone behind the glass, calling to her.

spans.text: Someone is knocking on the purple-hued glass walls of the room. There is someone behind the glass, calling to her.

units.rawText: Malkira once told her that those people were all redundant data who did not exist in this world, and even if they did, they would want nothing to do with her.
units.displayText: Malkira once told her that those people were all redundant data who did not exist in this world, and even if they did, they would want nothing to do with her.

spans.text: Malkira once told her that those people were all redundant data who did not exist in this world, and even if they did, they would want nothing to do with her.

units.rawText: But when she wipes the dust away from the window and sees the face beyond the glass, she knows the answer in her heart.
units.displayText: But when she wipes the dust away from the window and sees the face beyond the glass, she knows the answer in her heart.

spans.text: But when she wipes the dust away from the window and sees the face beyond the glass, she knows the answer in her heart.

units.rawText: She is not a stranger.
units.displayText: She is not a stranger.

spans.text: She is not a stranger.

units.rawText: Was everything that Lady Malkira told me... a lie?
units.displayText: Was everything that Lady Malkira told me... a lie?

spans.text: Was everything that Lady Malkira told me... a lie?

units.rawText: She raises her hand and looks at the dark purple in her palm. Her fingertips touch the scattered debris on the ground, and the pure operands there are promptly entropized into a dark purple.
units.displayText: She raises her hand and looks at the dark purple in her palm. Her fingertips touch the scattered debris on the ground, and the pure operands there are promptly entropized into a dark purple.

spans.text: She raises her hand and looks at the dark purple in her palm. Her fingertips touch the scattered debris on the ground, and the pure operands there are promptly entropized into a dark purple.

units.rawText: This is reality.
units.displayText: This is reality.

spans.text: This is reality.

units.rawText: But...
units.displayText: But...

spans.text: But...

units.rawText: If I am the Sol of which you speak, then who am I, as an Entropic?
units.displayText: If I am the Sol of which you speak, then who am I, as an Entropic?

spans.text: If I
am
the Sol of which you speak, then who am I, as an Entropic?

units.rawText: Huh?
units.displayText: Huh?

spans.text: Huh?

units.rawText: Persicaria stops in her tracks as she is confronted by a question she has never considered before. The cold gaze of the High Order Entropic stares at the fire burning in her chest, her eyes full of confusion.
units.displayText: Persicaria stops in her tracks as she is confronted by a question she has never considered before. The cold gaze of the High Order Entropic stares at the fire burning in her chest, her eyes full of confusion.

spans.text: Persicaria stops in her tracks as she is confronted by a question she has never considered before. The cold gaze of the High Order Entropic stares at the fire burning in her chest, her eyes full of confusion.

units.rawText: The "Sol" you're calling to is not me, but your friend, an agent like you.
units.displayText: The "Sol" you're calling to is not me, but your friend, an agent like you.

spans.text: The "Sol" you're calling to is not me, but your friend, an agent like you.

units.rawText: If I went to your side, then you would find the "Sol" that you were waiting for. But then... where would "Sol" the Entropic go?
units.displayText: If I went to your side, then you would find the "Sol" that you were waiting for. But then... where would "Sol" the Entropic go?

spans.text: If I went to your side, then you would find the "Sol" that you were waiting for. But then... where would "Sol" the Entropic go?

units.rawText: Sol looks up at Persicaria. The look in her eyes could almost be described as pleading.
units.displayText: Sol looks up at Persicaria. The look in her eyes could almost be described as pleading.

spans.text: Sol looks up at Persicaria. The look in her eyes could almost be described as pleading.

units.rawText: If you affirm the existence of that Sol, then it would mean my present self is meaningless, and I...
units.displayText: If you affirm the existence of that Sol, then it would mean my present self is meaningless, and I...

spans.text: If you affirm the existence of that Sol, then it would mean my present self is meaningless, and I...

units.rawText: I can't give up on who I am right now.
units.displayText: I can't give up on who I am right now.

spans.text: I can't give up on who I am right now.

units.rawText: The girl in the glass room plugs her ears and banishes all clamor outside.
units.displayText: The girl in the glass room plugs her ears and banishes all clamor outside.

spans.text: The girl in the glass room plugs her ears and banishes all clamor outside.

units.rawText: Sol... It's alright... you can be cured of being an Entropic...
units.displayText: Sol... It's alright... you can be cured of being an Entropic...

spans.text: Sol... It's alright... you can be cured of being an Entropic...

units.rawText: Then what about my memories, and my very existence that stands before you right now? Are you just going to delete them?
units.displayText: Then what about my memories, and my very existence that stands before you right now? Are you just going to delete them?

spans.text: Then what about my memories, and my very existence that stands before you right now? Are you just going to delete them?

units.rawText: Are you going to delete me to restore the person from your memories?
units.displayText: Are you going to delete me to restore the person from your memories?

spans.text: Are you going to delete
me
to restore the person from your memories?

units.rawText: Sol raises her head, and she suddenly feels utterly alien to Persicaria.
units.displayText: Sol raises her head, and she suddenly feels utterly alien to Persicaria.

spans.text: Sol raises her head, and she suddenly feels utterly alien to Persicaria.

units.rawText: These feelings, these memories, none of them belong to me... I won't let you influence me! I'll never let you consume me!
units.displayText: These feelings, these memories, none of them belong to me... I won't let you influence me! I'll never let you consume me!

spans.text: These feelings, these memories, none of them belong to me... I won't let you influence me! I'll never let you consume me!

units.rawText: <size=40>Now get lost!!!</size>
units.displayText: Now get lost!!!

spans.text: Now get lost!!!

units.rawText: The surrounding air seems to tremble with Sol's shout. Her voice is hoarse, but unshakably firm.
units.displayText: The surrounding air seems to tremble with Sol's shout. Her voice is hoarse, but unshakably firm.

spans.text: The surrounding air seems to tremble with Sol's shout. Her voice is hoarse, but unshakably firm.

units.rawText: I'll never betray Tartarus as long as I live.
units.displayText: I'll never betray Tartarus as long as I live.

spans.text: I'll never betray Tartarus as long as I live.

units.rawText: I have only one aim right now, which is to defeat you! I will cast out all you agents that are trying to deceive me!
units.displayText: I have only one aim right now, which is to defeat you! I will cast out all you agents that are trying to deceive me!

spans.text: I have only one aim right now, which is to defeat you! I will cast out all you agents that are trying to deceive me!

units.rawText: Almost at the same time, the surrounding liquid Entropy rises from the ground in the grip of some unseen force. They coalesce like water vapor, or perhaps like clouds of dust.
units.displayText: Almost at the same time, the surrounding liquid Entropy rises from the ground in the grip of some unseen force. They coalesce like water vapor, or perhaps like clouds of dust.

spans.text: Almost at the same time, the surrounding liquid Entropy rises from the ground in the grip of some unseen force. They coalesce like water vapor, or perhaps like clouds of dust.

units.rawText: The liquid Entropy surges toward the wound on Sol's chest, which heals shut before Persicaria's eyes.
units.displayText: The liquid Entropy surges toward the wound on Sol's chest, which heals shut before Persicaria's eyes.

spans.text: The liquid Entropy surges toward the wound on Sol's chest, which heals shut before Persicaria's eyes.

units.rawText: You... You're using the power of the Entropy...
units.displayText: You... You're using the power of the Entropy...

spans.text: You... You're using the power of the Entropy...

units.rawText: The remaining Low Order Entropics rally around Sol before suddenly disintegrating into liquid which pours toward the black-clad girl, who stands at the center of it all. The slime emits a creepy purple light as it touches her skin and then soaks into her body.
units.displayText: The remaining Low Order Entropics rally around Sol before suddenly disintegrating into liquid which pours toward the black-clad girl, who stands at the center of it all. The slime emits a creepy purple light as it touches her skin and then soaks into her body.

spans.text: The remaining Low Order Entropics rally around Sol before suddenly disintegrating into liquid which pours toward the black-clad girl, who stands at the center of it all. The slime emits a creepy purple light as it touches her skin and then soaks into her body.

units.rawText: Her confused eyes fill with purple mist. Her heart is probably the same, unable to accept reality because of the Entropy that fills it.
units.displayText: Her confused eyes fill with purple mist. Her heart is probably the same, unable to accept reality because of the Entropy that fills it.

spans.text: Her confused eyes fill with purple mist. Her heart is probably the same, unable to accept reality because of the Entropy that fills it.

units.rawText: So, what do you think of this? My destiny is shackled to the Tartarus Sector. So abandon your lofty condescension...
units.displayText: So, what do you think of this? My destiny is shackled to the Tartarus Sector. So abandon your lofty condescension...

spans.text: So, what do you think of this? My destiny is shackled to the Tartarus Sector. So abandon your lofty condescension...

units.rawText: And let go of me!!
units.displayText: And let go of me!!

spans.text: And let go of me!!

units.rawText: Sol's head jerks up with a ferocious cry and their blades clash once again.
units.displayText: Sol's head jerks up with a ferocious cry and their blades clash once again.

spans.text: Sol's head jerks up with a ferocious cry and their blades clash once again.

units.rawText: Clang!
units.displayText: Clang!

spans.text: Clang!

units.rawText: Persicaria barely manages to parry the strike, but her opponent shows no sign of stopping. Her attacks come quickly, every last one of them lethal.
units.displayText: Persicaria barely manages to parry the strike, but her opponent shows no sign of stopping. Her attacks come quickly, every last one of them lethal.

spans.text: Persicaria barely manages to parry the strike, but her opponent shows no sign of stopping. Her attacks come quickly, every last one of them lethal.

units.rawText: Come on!
units.displayText: Come on!

spans.text: Come on!

units.rawText: If you can't convince me, then show me your strength!
units.displayText: If you can't convince me, then show me your strength!

spans.text: If you can't convince me, then show me your strength!

units.rawText: After deflecting several attacks, Persicaria's breathing grows ragged. Sweat obscures her vision and the sword in her hand feels heavier with each swing.
units.displayText: After deflecting several attacks, Persicaria's breathing grows ragged. Sweat obscures her vision and the sword in her hand feels heavier with each swing.

spans.text: After deflecting several attacks, Persicaria's breathing grows ragged. Sweat obscures her vision and the sword in her hand feels heavier with each swing.

units.rawText: Hah... hah...
units.displayText: Hah... hah...

spans.text: Hah... hah...

units.rawText: (Her attacks are becoming faster. The Entropy is boosting her strength...)
units.displayText: Her attacks are becoming faster. The Entropy is boosting her strength...

spans.text: Her attacks are becoming faster. The Entropy is boosting her strength...

units.rawText: Come on!!
units.displayText: Come on!!

spans.text: Come on!!

units.rawText: Clang! Clang! Clang!
units.displayText: Clang! Clang! Clang!

spans.text: Clang! Clang! Clang!

units.rawText: Sol's offensive is like a killing storm. Every swing she makes feels as if it could cut through bone. Persicaria's hands are trembling as she is forced back in a wretched state, barely avoiding the lethal edge each time.
units.displayText: Sol's offensive is like a killing storm. Every swing she makes feels as if it could cut through bone. Persicaria's hands are trembling as she is forced back in a wretched state, barely avoiding the lethal edge each time.

spans.text: Sol's offensive is like a killing storm. Every swing she makes feels as if it could cut through bone. Persicaria's hands are trembling as she is forced back in a wretched state, barely avoiding the lethal edge each time.

units.rawText: (I'm no match for her now, especially since she's still...)
units.displayText: I'm no match for her now, especially since she's still...

spans.text: I'm no match for her now, especially since she's still...

units.rawText: I told you already! COME ON!!!
units.displayText: I told you already! COME ON!!!

spans.text: I told you already! COME ON!!!

units.rawText: Clang—
units.displayText: Clang—

spans.text: Clang—

units.rawText: (What am I even hesitating for? The Professor's trapped on the other side of that broken wall. What's the Professor going to do if I lose here?)
units.displayText: What am I even hesitating for? The Professor's trapped on the other side of that broken wall. What's the Professor going to do if I lose here?

spans.text: What am I even hesitating for? The Professor's trapped on the other side of that broken wall. What's the Professor going to do if I lose here?

units.rawText: (I can't commit myself to this because I want Sol to have been resurrected. Open your eyes and look, Persicaria. Right now, she's...)
units.displayText: I can't commit myself to this because I want Sol to have been resurrected. Open your eyes and look, Persicaria. Right now, she's...

spans.text: I can't commit myself to this because I want Sol to have been resurrected. Open your eyes and
look
, Persicaria. Right now, she's...

units.rawText: (Pant) This naked aggression of yours...
units.displayText: (Pant) This naked aggression of yours...

spans.text: (Pant) This naked aggression of yours...

units.rawText: Is NOTHING like Sol!
units.displayText: Is NOTHING like Sol!

spans.text: Is NOTHING like Sol!

units.rawText: Persicaria finally acquiesces to her opponent's provocations, deflecting an incoming strike and freeing herself from the combination of strikes, finally stabbing at her opponent's arm.
units.displayText: Persicaria finally acquiesces to her opponent's provocations, deflecting an incoming strike and freeing herself from the combination of strikes, finally stabbing at her opponent's arm.

spans.text: Persicaria finally acquiesces to her opponent's provocations, deflecting an incoming strike and freeing herself from the combination of strikes, finally stabbing at her opponent's arm.

units.rawText: The black-clad girl sweeps her glaive sideways and effortlessly blocks it.
units.displayText: The black-clad girl sweeps her glaive sideways and effortlessly blocks it.

spans.text: The black-clad girl sweeps her glaive sideways and effortlessly blocks it.

units.rawText: You can't convince me with those empty words, and you can't beat me with that feeble strength.
units.displayText: You can't convince me with those empty words, and you can't beat me with that feeble strength.

Persicaria is not the one who is hurt. The only thing below the incoming blade are severed tentacles and liquid Entropy that has splashed everywhere.

units.rawText: Sol...?
units.displayText: Sol...?

spans.text: Sol...?

units.displayText: No, that's wrong, that's not right...

units.rawText: Look, I know you're worried about me, Persicaria. But I'm not some frenzied berserker who doesn't care if she lives or dies. The reason why I can go all out like this is because I know you guys have my back.

units.displayText: She collapses into my shoulder, her body trembling.

spans.text: She collapses into my shoulder, her body trembling.

units.rawText: I kept saying I wouldn't let anyone take anything away from me any more, that I'd protect everyone, that I wouldn't allow myself to be trapped in the past... But I'm still a mess, even now...
units.displayText: I kept saying I wouldn't let anyone take anything away from me any more, that I'd protect everyone, that I wouldn't allow myself to be trapped in the past... But I'm still a mess, even now...

spans.text: I kept saying I wouldn't let anyone take anything away from me any more, that I'd protect everyone, that I wouldn't allow myself to be trapped in the past... But I'm still a mess, even now...

units.rawText: I just keep running away in confusion...
units.displayText: I just keep running away in confusion...

spans.text: I just keep running away in confusion...

units.rawText: I gently pat her back and switch to a consoling tone.
units.displayText: I gently pat her back and switch to a consoling tone.

spans.text: I gently pat her back and switch to a consoling tone.

units.rawText: It's okay, Persicaria. I understand how you feel.
units.displayText: It's okay, Persicaria. I understand how you feel.

spans.text: It's okay, Persicaria. I understand how you feel.

units.rawText: Sol is our friend. Neither I nor the Oasis will give up on her.
units.displayText: Sol is our friend. Neither I nor the Oasis will give up on her.

spans.text: Sol is our friend. Neither I nor the Oasis will give up on her.

units.rawText: Don't worry. I managed to stick Eos' earring on Sol when I attacked her just now. While the operands inside are depleted, it can just barely serve as a tracking device.
units.displayText: Don't worry. I managed to stick Eos' earring on Sol when I attacked her just now. While the operands inside are depleted, it can just barely serve as a tracking device.

spans.text: Don't worry. I managed to stick Eos' earring on Sol when I attacked her just now. While the operands inside are depleted, it can just barely serve as a tracking device.

units.rawText: So you're saying we can find her again?
units.displayText: So you're saying we can find her again?

spans.text: So you're saying we can find her again?

units.rawText: Yes, but first we need to recover the Rubik's Map. We'll only be able to catch up with her once we figure out the shifting of Tartarus' labyrinth.
units.displayText: Yes, but first we need to recover the Rubik's Map. We'll only be able to catch up with her once we figure out the shifting of Tartarus' labyrinth.

units.rawText: The Rubik's Map...

units.rawText: Persicaria looks into the depths of the Watchtower. The silvery cube remains in place, sparkling with a light that calls to mind the enigmatic smile of the gods...
